supported.guidance: Install each specialist Skill into ~/.claude/skills. The managed runtime uses only the matching Pure Tokens Claude Code connection fields for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.agents/skills. The managed runtime uses only the active matching Pure Tokens Codex connection credential for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.workbuddy/skills. The managed runtime uses only matching Pure Tokens model credentials from WorkBuddy model configuration for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.gemini/skills. The managed runtime uses only the matching Pure Tokens Gemini CLI API-key connection for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.grok/skills. The managed runtime uses only matching Pure Tokens model credentials from Grok Build model configuration for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.config/opencode/skills. The managed runtime uses only the matching Pure Tokens OpenCode provider credential for fixed API requests.
Install each specialist Skill into ~/.trae/skills. Trae is manual-configuration-only and has no approved local credential resolver for direct Skill API requests.
